description: Padma Warnalatha Thennakoon and 2 Others Vs. Commissioner General of Agrarian Development and Others. Padma Warnalatha Thennakoon and 2 Others Vs. Commissioner General of Agrarian Development and Others. View More before Hon. K.M.S. Dissanayake, J.
parties: Padma Warnalatha Thennakoon and 2 Others Vs. Commissioner General of Agrarian Development and Others. Padma Warnalatha Thennakoon and 2 Others Vs. Commissioner General of Agrarian Development and Others. View More
keywords: An Appeal from a judgment of the High Court established under Article 154P(1) of the Constitution in the exercise of the writ jurisdiction vested in it under Article 154P(4)(b) of the Constitution from an order made by the Assistant Commissioner of Agrarian Development by virtue of the powers vested in her by the Agrarian Development Act as amended-3 Conditions precedent to invoke the writ jurisdiction of the High Court of the Province from an order made by the Assistant Commissioner of Agrarian Development by virtue of the powers vested in her by the Agrarian Development Act as amended-the distinction between the powers exercisable by the Commissioner General of Agrarian Development by himself and the Additional Commissioner General of Agrarian Development and the Commissioners of Agrarian Development “on an island wide basis” under and by virtue of section 38 of the Agrarian Development Act as amended and the powers exercisable by the Deputy Commissioner of Agrarian Development and the Assistant Commissioner of Agrarian Development “only within the area to which they have been appointed” thereunder-Is a decision made by Assistant Commissioner of Agrarian Development under the provisions of the Agrarian Development Act as amended, amendable to writ jurisdiction of the High Court of the Province established under Article 154P(1) of the Constitution as amended.
legistation: Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka-Article 138, 154P(1), 154P(4)(b), 154P(6)-section 3 of the High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act No. 19 of 1990, section 38 and 83 of the Agrarian Development Act No. 46 of 2000 as amended by Section 16, Act No. 26 of 2011.
